Definition: Gichon, a river of Paradise; also a valley (or pool) near Jerusalem
BiblicalUsage: Gihon is the river that watered Eden, one of the four rivers of the garden, and it is also the spring beside Jerusalem where Solomon was anointed king. The name means bursting forth, and the water it names runs from the garden story straight into Israel's history.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gihon matters because God's story happened in real places, and Gihon is one of them.
